title: Beyond Strike Remapping: Conditional-Gamma Pricing of Leveraged ETF Options under Local Volatility
abstract: arXiv:2611.22604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Options on leveraged ETFs (LETFs) are priced and hedged off the LETF volatility surface, but path-dependent variance drag makes that surface difficult to build consistently with the underlying index smile. We study three methods for constructing it: a closed-form first-order strike remapping, a new conditional-Gamma method, and a two-dimensional joint-law PDE that makes no distributional assumption and serves as the benchmark. The conditional-Gamma method is our main contribution. It conditions on the terminal underlying return, which preserves the state dependence of variance drag that a single remapped strike discards. Three one-dimensional forward PDEs under a calibrated local-volatility model give the conditional mean and variance of integrated variance, and a Gamma law matched to these moments keeps realised variance non-negative and prices the option in closed form. translated_title: 超越行权价重映射：局部波动率下杠杆ETF期权的条件伽马定价
translated_abstract: 杠杆ETF（LETF）期权的定价与对冲基于LETF波动率曲面，但路径依赖的方差损耗使得该曲面难以与标的指数的波动率微笑保持一致地构建。我们研究了三种构建该曲面的方法：闭式一阶行权价重映射、一种新的条件伽马方法，以及一个不作任何分布假设的二维联合律偏微分方程（作为基准）。条件伽马方法是我们的主要贡献。它以标的最终收益率作为条件，从而保留了单个重映射行权价所舍弃的方差损耗的状态依赖性。在校准后的局部波动率模型下，三个一维远期偏微分方程给出已实现积分方差的条件均值与条件方差，而与这些矩相匹配的伽马分布保证了已实现方差的非负性，并以闭式形式为期权定价。一个同时匹配条件三阶矩的平移伽马变体……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文的主要贡献是提出一种新的条件伽马定价方法：通过以标的最终收益率为条件来保留方差损耗的状态依赖性，在校准的局部波动率模型下用三个一维远期偏微分方程计算积分方差的条件矩，并匹配伽马分布，从而以闭式形式对杠杆ETF期权定价，同时保持已实现方差非负。
en_tdlr: The main contribution is a new conditional-Gamma method that prices leveraged ETF options in closed form under local volatility by conditioning on the terminal underlying return to preserve the state dependence of variance drag, using three one-dimensional forward PDEs to obtain conditional moments of integrated variance matched with a Gamma law that keeps realised variance non-negative.
